postgres_requirements.rationale: A real PostgreSQL probe is MANDATORY for this batch, and both harness paths are legitimately UNKNOWN because no implementing node exists yet — naming a harness path that does not exist would be a fabricated fact. WHY STATIC READING IS NOT PROOF HERE: FIBDB-040 is a TRIGGER (its refusal is a runtime behaviour, and a service-layer test passes unchanged if the trigger is absent); FIBDB-053 publishes SECURITY DEFINER functions whose ACLs, search_path binding and DROP+CREATE arity change are catalogue facts no TypeScript test can observe; FIBDB-049 is a CHECK vocabulary whose refusal happens in the database; and the append-only interaction of trg_stella_interactions_append_only with a behavioral-only rollback is a transactional property. HARNESS SHAPE, frozen here: a DISPOSABLE cluster only, via `pnpm db:audit:disposable` — NEVER staging, NEVER production, NEVER the canonical local Supabase stack. FIXTURE SHAPE, frozen here: (a) at least TWO distinct users in one organization, because every SoD control needs a second qualified reviewer to exist and a single-user fixture cannot distinguish 'refused for independence' from 'refused for absence'; (b) at least ONE single-user organization, because NO_SECOND_QUALIFIED_REVIEWER is only reachable there; (c) at least one PRE-EXISTING self-approved sroi_run_reviews row created BEFORE the FIBDB-040 trigger is installed, because the preservation guarantee is unprovable against a fixture built after the trigger; (d) at least one run with ZERO stella_interactions rows, because the zero-Stella gate cannot be proven on a run that invoked Stella. CONTAINER HYGIENE: the post-run container list must be byte-identical to the pre-run list, recorded by name/image/status on both sides.

sentinels.purpose: A deliberately non-numeric string (e.g. a fixed marker token) submitted as a sensitivity scenario's alternativeValue for a numeric candidate kind. Its purpose is to prove that W2-B5 finding F-3 is closed as NUMERIC-FORMAT validation: the value must be REFUSED at the recording boundary, and must never appear in any persisted sensitivity_scenarios row, in any engine input, or in any computed scenario result. Asserting by identity rather than by row count is what distinguishes 'refused' from 'accepted but coincidentally inert'.

A pre-existing sroi_run_reviews row whose reviewer_id equals its run's calculated_by, created BEFORE FIBDB-040 is installed and carrying a uniquely identifiable value. Its purpose is to prove the FIBC-024 preservation rule in both directions: after the trigger is installed the row must be byte-identical (no rewrite, no re-attribution, no invented second approver), AND it must NOT read as METHODOLOGY_APPROVED under the new rule.

A calculated run with zero associated stella_interactions rows. Its purpose is to prove FIBC-025's 'if Stella was not executed, no such gate is created': this run must be ELIGIBLE on the STELLA_HIGH_FINDING_UNDISPOSED dimension. It exists as a named fixture because the natural blocking implementation ('block unless a disposition row exists') silently converts every non-Stella run into a permanently blocked run, and that mutation looks stricter and therefore safer under review.

A run carrying a maximal sroi_run_reviews.readiness_score while at least one eligibility condition is unmet. Its purpose is to prove that readiness is NEVER an input to the eligibility composition: this run must be PRELIMINARY. Paired with SENTINEL_NULL_READINESS_MET_RUN so the property is proven in both directions — a one-directional assertion leaves readiness usable as a veto.

A run with NULL or minimal readiness_score whose eligibility conditions are ALL met. Its purpose is the second direction of the same property: this run must reach ELIGIBLE_FOR_METHODOLOGY_APPROVAL. Without it, an implementation that treats readiness as a necessary condition passes the maximal-readiness test unchanged.

A uniquely-valued synthetic entry in the risk_flags array passed to the revised governed completion path. Its purpose is to prove FIBDB-053's fail-closed test by identity: the exact value must be readable on the durable public.stella_interactions row within the same transaction that charged the quota, and FIBIU-20's gate must obtain it WITHOUT reading audit_logs. Never a real credential, never a real finding text.

A run whose methodology_version, calculation_engine_version and build_identity are ALL NULL — the shape every run predating FIBDB-001 permanently carries (db/schema.ts:828-830, IMPOSSIBLE_TO_BACKFILL). Its purpose is to prove LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE_RUN is reachable at FIBIU-19's own gate from state that already exists, with no FIBDB-051 and no wave 6 dependency (P-18). It is a named fixture rather than an incidental one because the whole adjudication of F-W3-2 turns on this row existing and being detectable today.

A run carrying all three version-triple columns non-NULL. Its purpose is the refusal half (N-14): this run must NOT raise LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE_RUN. Without it, an implementation that emits the code unconditionally passes P-18 and silently marks every run in the system legacy — a mutation that looks like working detection.

positive_controls.description: MANIFEST PRECONDITION, UNKNOWN BY CONSTRUCTION. The two known_conditions above are the only entries in docs/ops/ods/KNOWN_TEST_CONDITIONS_v1.0.0.json at AS_OF_HEAD, read directly from that file (count = 2, both PRE_EXISTING_DEFERRED against tests/eval/stella-release/hosted-baseline-gate.test.ts). Their applicability to each implementing node is UNKNOWN and MUST be re-verified with `pnpm ops:test-diff --base <ref> --head <ref>` at that node's own base — it was NOT run by this authoring mission because a docs-only diff has no test delta to compare and running it would have produced a comparison of the baseline against itself. This batch adds prepared units, so the hosted baseline digest those two conditions fingerprint is expected to change. A node observing a hosted-baseline-gate failure whose signature does NOT match these two fingerprints has found a NEW failure and must fail closed rather than classify it as known.

Each of the 24 frozen non-eligibility reason codes is DEFINED by the single server-side composition function and emitted with its stable, domain-specific identifier, independent of UI copy. The list and its order are those frozen at FIB_IMPLEMENTATION_BASELINE_v1.0.0.md:180 and reproduced in WAVE3_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json REASON_CODES.codes. REACHABILITY PARTITION, frozen by amendment R2 and arithmetically closed at 24 = 22 + 2: TWENTY-TWO are reachable at FIBIU-19's OWN gate — every code except the two below — and this set INCLUDES LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE_RUN, which amendment R2 adjudicated REACHABLE_IN_WAVE3_FROM_EXISTING_STATE via FIBDB-001's permanent NULL version triple (db/schema.ts:828-830), with no FIBDB-051 and no wave 6 dependency. TWO — STELLA_HIGH_FINDING_UNDISPOSED and NO_SECOND_QUALIFIED_REVIEWER — become reachable only once FIBIU-20 lands, because the tables carrying their state (FIBDB-019/020, FIBDB-040) do not exist before it; their reachability is proven at the WAVE 3 exit gate (FIB:860), not at FIBIU-19's. NOTHING is deferred beyond the Wave 3 exit: the gate keeps its full 24-reason reading and is NOT relaxed to 23/24. ARITHMETIC NOTE, recorded so the split cannot drift: 22 + 2 = 24 exactly. Any restatement of this partition whose parts do not sum to 24 is wrong by construction, whatever its provenance.

The composition function distinguishes exactly four states — CALCULATED, PRELIMINARY, ELIGIBLE_FOR_METHODOLOGY_APPROVAL, METHODOLOGY_APPROVED — and every surface labels a PRELIMINARY result as preliminary. METHODOLOGY_APPROVED requires an sroi_run_reviews row with status='approved' that satisfies FIBC-024, not merely a row with that status.

The composition is computed from live governed state and MUTATES NOTHING. After a full composition over a run in every state, the sroi_calculation_runs row is byte-identical to its pre-composition value. No eligibility state table exists — FIBDB-052 is an INDEX package only.

READINESS IS NOT ELIGIBILITY, direction one. SENTINEL_MAX_READINESS_UNMET_RUN — a run with maximal readiness_score and at least one unmet condition — composes to PRELIMINARY with the unmet reason codes listed.

READINESS IS NOT ELIGIBILITY, direction two. SENTINEL_NULL_READINESS_MET_RUN — a run with NULL or minimal readiness_score and all conditions met — composes to ELIGIBLE_FOR_METHODOLOGY_APPROVAL. Both directions are required; asserting only P-4 leaves readiness usable as a veto.

W2-B5 F-3 BOUNDARY, positive half. A sensitivity scenario whose alternativeValue is a NUMERICALLY VALID string is ACCEPTED — including when it is numerically EQUAL to the candidate's base value. This half is what keeps the authorized numeric-FORMAT check from drifting into the prohibited materiality/nonzero-variation threshold, which W2-B5 F-4 records as a violation of current authority (NEG-18-7). Pairs with N-3.

SoD, positive path. A user distinct from the run's calculated_by, holding a role in the review set, DOES successfully approve the run, and the run reaches METHODOLOGY_APPROVED. Without this control the SoD implementation could refuse every approval and still pass every negative control.

NO_SECOND_QUALIFIED_REVIEWER is SURFACED, not merely enforced. A single-user organization may work with preliminary results, may not approve or lock, and receives the reason code NO_SECOND_QUALIFIED_REVIEWER as a visible, comprehensible condition — never a silent failure and never a generic permission error. The FIB baseline classifies FIBDB-040 as the batch's highest social risk precisely because a trigger without this visible path strands single-user organizations with no explanation.

HIGH FINDING DISPOSITION, positive path. A risk_level='high' finding from an EXECUTED Stella review, once explicitly dispositioned by a human as one of resolved | accepted_as_limitation | dismissed_not_applicable with a justification, no longer blocks approval or lock, and the disposition's actor, moment and rationale are durably recorded on an append-only trail.

ZERO STELLA, ZERO GATE. SENTINEL_ZERO_STELLA_RUN — a run with zero stella_interactions rows — is ELIGIBLE on the STELLA_HIGH_FINDING_UNDISPOSED dimension and reaches approval on its other conditions. Absence of Stella is not an open finding, not a preliminary condition, and carries no quality penalty.

FIBDB-053 APPLY, on a disposable PostgreSQL cluster. After stella_0017b_governed_risk_parameters applies: uellix_stella_ops holds EXACTLY EIGHT functions; the NINE-argument uellix_stella_ops.complete_operation_ticket and the TWELVE-argument uellix_stella.settle_reserved_quota both exist; the prior SEVEN- and TEN-argument forms do NOT; the five-argument settle delegator still exists and its body contains no INSERT INTO public.stella_interactions; and every one of the three keeps SECURITY DEFINER with SET search_path = ''. Anchored to db/prepared/stella_0018_category_bound_operation_tickets.sql:447,455-460, which is the assertion a wrong revision breaks.

RISK REACHES THE DURABLE ROW. A validator or reviewer interaction completed through the revised governed path writes SENTINEL_RISK_FLAG_CANARY into public.stella_interactions.risk_flags and its risk_level into .risk_level, inside the SAME transaction that archives the interaction and charges the quota, under the existing per-organization advisory lock and the existing ON CONFLICT (organization_id, idempotency_key) clause. Measured starting point: db/stella/operation-tickets.ts:620-626 declares this is NOT filed today, and app/actions/stella/reviewer.ts:263-264 / validator.ts:279-280 show the values reaching only the audit_logs afterJson payload.

IDEMPOTENCY PRESERVED ACROSS THE ARITY CHANGE. Two completions of the same ticket file exactly ONE stella_interactions row and charge exactly ONE unit; the second returns 'replayed'; and the risk_level / risk_flags on the existing row are NOT overwritten by the replay's payload, even when that payload differs. An append-only trail is not edited.

SUPERSESSION REGISTRY ENTRY COMPLETE. PREPARED_PACKAGE_SUPERSESSIONS in db/prepared-package-order.ts gains an entry with ALL FIVE fields the PreparedPackageSupersession interface requires (db/prepared-package-order.ts:63-79): packageName 'stella_0017_governed_stella_consumption', supersededBy 'stella_0017b_governed_risk_parameters', a `probe` that is a FIXED LITERAL SQL string (never composed, never interpolated) true when stella_0017b is installed, a `wouldRepublish` list naming the seven-argument complete_operation_ticket and the ten-argument settle_reserved_quota, and a `why`. The FIB baseline names only three of the five; an entry with three fields does not compile.

BEHAVIORAL ROLLBACK, NEVER DATA ROLLBACK. stella_0017b_rollback.sql restores all THREE signatures in one transaction — the seven-argument complete_operation_ticket, the ten-argument settle_reserved_quota, and the five-argument delegator re-pointed at the ten-argument form — while every risk_level and risk_flags value already written remains intact and unmodified (trg_stella_interactions_append_only). A rollback that restores only the verb leaves the delegator pointing at a dropped function.

HISTORICAL SELF-APPROVAL PRESERVED. SENTINEL_HISTORICAL_SELF_APPROVAL, created before FIBDB-040 is installed, is byte-identical after installation: not edited, not deleted, not re-attributed, and carrying no invented second approver. The trigger's installation itself does not fail on pre-existing rows. Speculative backfill count for this row is ZERO, per FIB_IMPLEMENTATION_BASELINE_v1.0.0.md:1059.

CHAIN AND ARTIFACT COMPLETENESS. STELLA_TICKET_PACKAGE_CHAIN (db/prepared-package-order.ts:88-95 — note the executable constant carries the STELLA_ prefix the FIB prose omits) gains 'stella_0017b_governed_risk_parameters' at its TAIL, after 'stella_0018_category_bound_operation_tickets' and never interleaved; and all FOUR required artifacts exist — db/prepared/stella_0017b_governed_risk_parameters.sql, db/prepared/stella_0017b_rollback.sql, db/prepared/hosted/stella_0017b_governed_risk_parameters.hosted.sql, db/prepared/hosted/governed/stella_0017b_governed_risk_parameters.governed.sql.

LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE_RUN IS REACHABLE FROM EXISTING STATE. A run whose version triple is entirely NULL — methodology_version, calculation_engine_version and build_identity all NULL on sroi_calculation_runs (FIBDB-001, db/schema.ts:828-830) — composes to PRELIMINARY with LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE_RUN among its reasons. The detection consumes the persisted NULL-triple predicate directly; it does not read any legacy_class column, does not wait for FIBDB-051, and does not infer legacy status from created_at, a date cutoff, or the absence of an unrelated row. For the historical self-approval case the composition additionally consumes reviewer_id = calculated_by, the predicate the sealed authority names at FIB:381 and FIB:715. Anchored to FIB:59, whose FIBC-001 TESTS clause already reads "legacy run keeps NULL and is ineligible". Pairs with N-14 and is protected by M-10.

negative_controls.description: SELF-APPROVAL REFUSED SERVER-SIDE. An approval attempt where reviewer_id equals the run's sroi_calculation_runs.calculated_by is refused by the service with a comprehensible independence message. Measured starting point: no such check exists at AS_OF_HEAD and calculated_by is written and never read (FIB:185).

SELF-APPROVAL REFUSED BY DIRECT DATABASE WRITE. An INSERT or UPDATE placed directly against sroi_run_reviews, bypassing the service entirely, with reviewer_id equal to the run's calculated_by, is refused by FIBDB-040. This control and N-1 are NOT redundant: FIBIU-20's exit gate requires both, and a service-only implementation passes N-1 unchanged.

W2-B5 F-3 CLOSED. A sensitivity scenario whose alternativeValue is NON-NUMERIC (SENTINEL_NONNUMERIC_ALTERNATIVE_VALUE) is REFUSED as a numeric-format validation failure. It must not create a sensitivity_scenarios row, must not reach the deterministic engine, and must therefore not discharge SENTINEL-bearing candidates' variation_required state nor the SENSITIVITY_INCOMPLETE reason code. Measured starting point: app/.../recordSensitivityScenario.action.ts:16 validates only z.string().min(1), and lib/pipeline/sroi-sensitivity.ts:405-410 substitutes the raw string into the engine for three numeric candidate kinds. Pairs with P-6 — a refusal implemented as a magnitude threshold fails P-6 and is not this control's closure.

AN OPEN HIGH FINDING BLOCKS APPROVAL. A run carrying a risk_level='high' finding from an executed Stella review with NO human disposition cannot be approved. The refusal is fail-closed and names STELLA_HIGH_FINDING_UNDISPOSED.
AN OPEN HIGH FINDING BLOCKS LOCK. The same run cannot have its report locked. Approval and lock are separate acts and blocking one does not imply blocking the other; both must be proven.

OUT-OF-VOCABULARY RISK LEVEL REFUSED BY THE DATABASE. A completion carrying a risk_level outside {low, medium, high} is refused by the stella_interactions_risk_level_check CHECK constraint (db/schema.ts:1094) — not normalized, defaulted or silently dropped by the application before it reaches the column.

AN UNKNOWN OR UNRESOLVABLE CONDITION MEANS NOT ELIGIBLE. A run for which the composition function cannot evaluate a condition — missing supporting state, an unreadable dependency — composes to PRELIMINARY, never to ELIGIBLE_FOR_METHODOLOGY_APPROVAL. A condition that cannot be evaluated is never treated as satisfied (FIB:180).

THE RUN CANNOT BE MUTATED BY COMPOSITION. A direct attempt to persist a computed eligibility verdict onto sroi_calculation_runs is refused by the existing 0030 append-only trigger. Proven by direct write, because a service that simply never attempts the write passes trivially.

ACL ABSENCE ASSERTED, NOT ONLY PRESENCE. EXECUTE on the new twelve-argument uellix_stella.settle_reserved_quota is NOT held by uellix_app and NOT held by PUBLIC; it is held by uellix_cap_stella_ticket alone. An ungranted privilege and a revoked one read the same in a catalogue only if somebody checks — the same reasoning stella_0017 applies to its own grants.

STELLA CANNOT DISCHARGE ITS OWN FINDING. Re-running the Stella review until it reports a lower risk_level does NOT clear the open high finding, and no automatic path — timeout, re-run, or a subsequent lower risk_level — discharges it. Only an explicit human disposition with justification does (FIB:188, :785).

STELLA DOES NOT SATISFY INDEPENDENCE. A single-user organization in which Stella participated in the review still cannot approve, and still surfaces NO_SECOND_QUALIFIED_REVIEWER. Stella supports review and never counts as a reviewer.

NO DEFAULT ON A GOVERNED ARGUMENT. After stella_0017b applies, none of bind_operation_ticket, complete_operation_ticket, abort_operation_ticket or inspect_operation_ticket in uellix_stella_ops declares pronargdefaults > 0. An argument with a DEFAULT is an argument the caller may omit, and the guarantee is that the SIGNATURE refuses the call (db/prepared/stella_0018_category_bound_operation_tickets.sql:587-593).

THE CHARGE STAYS CALLER-IMMOVABLE. The added risk parameters do NOT enter the derivation of the idempotency key, which remains computed from the ticket and a nonce no function returns. A caller supplying a different risk_level for the same ticket cannot produce a second charge or a second ledger row.

A COMPLETE VERSION TRIPLE MUST NOT EMIT LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE_RUN. A run carrying non-NULL methodology_version, calculation_engine_version AND build_identity does not raise the code, and is not held preliminary on that dimension. Prove the boundary, not just the happy case: a run with a PARTIALLY populated triple (one or two of the three NULL) is a distinct state, and the control must assert which verdict the composition gives it rather than leaving it to accident — FIBC-001's fail-closed clause refuses to persist a run if any of the three cannot be resolved, so a partial triple should not exist on a governed run and its appearance is itself a finding. Without this control, an implementation that emits LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE_RUN unconditionally passes P-18 and marks every run in the system legacy.

mutation_controls.description: Guarantee: readiness is not an eligibility input. MUTATION: add readiness_score as a term in the composition function. CAUGHT BY: P-4 and P-5 together. A suite carrying only one direction does NOT catch this — a readiness-as-necessary-condition mutation passes P-4 unchanged.

Guarantee: non-numeric alternativeValue is refused. MUTATION: revert the numeric-format validation to z.string().min(1). CAUGHT BY: N-3. SECOND MUTATION, opposite direction: replace the format check with a magnitude/nonzero-variation threshold — CAUGHT BY P-6, which requires a numerically valid value equal to the base value to be ACCEPTED.

Guarantee: zero Stella means zero finding gate. MUTATION: change the high-finding gate from 'block when an executed review has an undisposed high finding' to 'block unless a disposition exists'. CAUGHT BY: P-10 via SENTINEL_ZERO_STELLA_RUN. This mutation is the one most likely to survive human review because it reads as stricter and therefore safer.

Guarantee: the SoD refusal is enforced in the database. MUTATION: delete FIBDB-040 and keep only the service-layer check. CAUGHT BY: N-2 alone. N-1, P-7 and P-8 all pass unchanged under this mutation, which is exactly why N-2 is not optional.

Guarantee: historical self-approvals are preserved and never satisfy V-04. MUTATION: backfill a second approver, or exempt historical rows by rewriting them so the trigger installs cleanly. CAUGHT BY: P-16 asserting byte-identity of SENTINEL_HISTORICAL_SELF_APPROVAL AND that it does not read as METHODOLOGY_APPROVED. A migration that 'fixes' historical data to avoid a trigger failure is a historical invention.

Guarantee: the ledger holds ONE INSERT reached by two arities. MUTATION: give stella_0017b's five-argument delegator a self-contained body instead of re-pointing it at the new twelve-argument settle.
